data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 diagnoses the §11.3 sustained flags as a procedural false positive but provides no evidence that any critic's internal logic would actually have passed §11.3's transparency requirement. The claim that the flag is mechanical rather than substantive is asserted, not demonstrated — no critic decision boundary is exhibited, and no concrete case is made that any flagged critic's logic satisfies the standard. Without showing even one critic whose internal logic meets §11.3, the procedural-false-positive conclusion is unsupported: the opacity flag may well be substantively correct.
